_comment: Self-paced improvement roadmap for the cheat-sheet app. Autonomous multi-session build: each batch is implemented fully, tested, committed, then a wakeup is scheduled ~1min later to continue with the next pending batch. HARD RULE (from owner): 100% local, ZERO external runtime dependencies, NO AI/cloud features. gzip etc. must use Node built-ins (zlib). HTB/THM checklists are authored at build-time and baked as STATIC data — the app never phones home. On each wakeup: read this file, pick the first 'pending' batch, implement it, run `npm test`, commit with a 'feat:'/'fix:' message, mark 'done', schedule next wakeup.
owner_priorities: Tag filter under the search box is buggy — must work correctly

Overhaul Write-ups AND Machines (design + functionality). Machines: situation-aware checklists (Linux/Windows privesc, Web, AD multi-machine with captured creds/loot, etc.) baked from HTB/THM/OSCP methodology; strong visual presentation that references the next steps while solving a box

constraints.built_ins_only_for_perf: use node:zlib for compression, no 'compression' package
constraints.typescript_devdep: avoid — keep dependency-free (JSDoc only if ever needed)
